next.reason: Start point and replacement by the next REPLACE are the same for 1985 programs: 'placed in the active state at the point at which it is encountered' (§2023:7.2.4.4 GR6); 'A format 1 REPLACE statement without the ALSO phrase cancels the active REPLACE statement' (§2023:7.2.4.4 GR7). The end differs: 1985 ends at 'the end of the separately compiled program', while §2023:7.2.4.4 GR5 keeps it active until 'the end of the compilation group is reached', and a compilation group is a 'sequence of one or more compilation units' (§2023:3.40). In a 1985 sequence of programs (1985 END PROGRAM header rule) a REPLACE now carries into the following programs. ALSO/LAST are 2023-only additions.
